 "content": "def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    # Treat 5 as panel dividers. Each row/column panel is 4x4, with a seed shape in leftmost panels.
    # For each horizontal band, take its colored seed (left cell block) and tile it in all four columns;
    # convert seed foreground to that band's color.
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    row_starts=[r for r in range(h) if all(v==5 for v in grid[r])]
    col_starts=[c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c]==5 for r in range(h))]
    rb=[0]+[r+1 for r in row_starts]
    re=row_starts+[h]
    cb=[0]+[c+1 for c in col_starts]
    ce=col_starts+[w]
    for i,(r0,r1) in enumerate(zip(rb,re)):
        # Seed in first panel, use the color already specified there
        seed=grid[r0:r1]
        color=next((x for row in seed for x in row if x not in (0,5)),0)
        for j,(c0,c1) in enumerate(zip(cb,ce)):
            for r in range(r0,r1):
                for c in range(c0,c1):
                    v=grid[r][c]
                    out[r][c]=color if v not in (0,5) else 0
    return out
